divineFrequencyBeginnerGuide.title: Divine Frequency Beginner Guide
divineFrequencyBeginnerGuide.intro: The opening hours reward careful exploration, deliberate combat, and consistent resource management. Follow these steps to establish a reliable routine before experimenting with advanced builds or optional discoveries.

steps.title: Learn the basic combat rhythm
steps.description: Use cover, control the distance to enemies, and avoid spending every resource in the first exchange. Test both firearm and psionic options early so you understand which tools are effective at different ranges.
tips: Do not rush into unfamiliar rooms without checking exits and nearby cover.
Use the safest available option when learning a new enemy encounter.
Preserve powerful abilities for groups, dangerous targets, or blocked routes.

steps.title: Explore methodically and mark your route
steps.description: Opening areas can contain branching paths, locked access points, optional encounters, and resources that are easier to identify when you keep a consistent route through each location.
tips: Check side rooms before advancing through a major objective area.
Remember doors, paths, and containers that cannot yet be opened.
Use landmarks and completed objectives to avoid repeatedly searching the same spaces.

steps.title: Manage resources before upgrading
steps.description: Treat ammunition, healing supplies, upgrade materials, and psionic resources as part of the same survival budget. Spend them when they solve a clear problem rather than immediately after acquiring them.
tips: Keep a reserve for unavoidable combat and progression blockers.
Compare an upgrade's immediate benefit with the value of saving its materials.
Avoid committing to a specialized setup until you understand your preferred combat role.

steps.title: Build a simple progression plan
steps.description: Choose one reliable damage approach first, then add complementary modifications or abilities. A focused early setup is easier to use than several partially developed options.
tips: Start with improvements that make ordinary encounters more consistent.
Add specialization after identifying which situations cause the most trouble.
Revisit your setup when a new area introduces different combat demands.

steps.title: Avoid common Early Access mistakes
steps.description: Do not assume every blocked path is a bug, every optional room must be cleared immediately, or every resource should be spent as soon as it appears. Early Access content may also change between updates.
tips: Separate unfinished or inaccessible content from objectives required for current progression.
Keep notes about unresolved paths and return after major story advances.
Explore optional content when your resources and equipment can support the risk.

divineFrequencyWeaponsAndMods.title: Divine Frequency Weapons and Mods
divineFrequencyWeaponsAndMods.intro: Divine Frequency supports more than one approach to combat. The most useful comparison is not simply raw damage, but how each option handles range, pressure, resource limits, and the type of encounter in front of you.

rows.bestUse: Open engagements, controlled target elimination, and situations where maintaining distance is safer than closing in
rows.upgradeFocus: Damage consistency, handling, accuracy, and ammunition efficiency
rows.recommendedPairing: A psionic option that provides control, utility, or a way to respond when enemies close the distance

rows.bestUse: Situations requiring crowd control, unusual access, burst damage, or a response that does not depend on conventional ammunition
rows.upgradeFocus: Effect strength, recovery, duration, range, and resource efficiency
rows.recommendedPairing: A dependable firearm for sustained damage when abilities are unavailable or better saved

rows.bestUse: Adapting a weapon or ability to a preferred range, damage pattern, or encounter type
rows.mainResource: Upgrade materials and available modification capacity
rows.upgradeFocus: Complementary bonuses rather than stacking unrelated effects
rows.recommendedPairing: A focused primary weapon and a secondary option that covers its main weakness

rows.bestUse: Exploration-heavy sections containing mixed enemy pressure, limited resources, and changing engagement distances
rows.mainResource: A shared reserve of ammunition, abilities, healing, and upgrade materials
rows.upgradeFocus: Consistency first, then a small number of complementary specializations
rows.recommendedPairing: One consistent firearm, one flexible psionic option, and modifications that improve the same combat plan

divineFrequencyClassesAndBuilds.title: Divine Frequency Classes and Builds
divineFrequencyClassesAndBuilds.intro: A good build should make ordinary encounters easier without leaving you helpless when the situation changes. These archetype cards organize the available play styles around their strengths, weaknesses, and preferred combinations of firearms, psionic options, and modifications.

cards.name: Firearms-Focused Archetype
cards.role: Ranged pressure and consistent weapon damage
strengths: Clear and dependable damage at range
Works well for players who prefer direct combat
weaknesses: Depends on ammunition and weapon handling
Can become less comfortable when enemies force close-range engagements
May need utility support for unusual encounters
cards.beginnerBuild: Use one dependable firearm as the primary damage source, invest in consistency before specialization, and keep a psionic option available for emergencies or utility.
cards.hybridOption: Add defensive, control, or mobility-oriented psionic improvements without diverting too many resources from the main firearm.
cards.recommendedFor: Players who prefer readable encounters, deliberate positioning, and conventional ranged combat

cards.name: Psionics-Focused Archetype
strengths: Can respond to varied encounter conditions
Provides tools beyond direct weapon damage
Supports experimentation with different ability combinations
weaknesses: Limited by ability availability and resource recovery
Requires more attention to timing and encounter priority
Can become inefficient when every ability is used against minor threats
cards.beginnerBuild: Choose a small set of dependable psionic tools, save high-impact effects for dangerous encounters, and carry a firearm for sustained damage between ability uses.
cards.hybridOption: Pair a primary psionic plan with a modest firearm investment that covers long engagements and resource-constrained areas.
cards.recommendedFor: Players who enjoy flexible tools, encounter control, and active resource decisions

cards.name: Hybrid Archetype
cards.role: Balanced coverage across firearms and psionic options
strengths: Handles changing ranges and encounter types
Reduces dependence on a single resource
Allows gradual experimentation before committing to specialization
weaknesses: Can waste upgrade materials across too many options
Requires a clear priority to avoid becoming unfocused
cards.beginnerBuild: Select one primary damage method and use the second system to solve its most important weakness. Upgrade consistency first, then add situational tools.
cards.hybridOption: Maintain one strong firearm, one frequently useful psionic option, and modifications that reinforce the same range or encounter plan.
cards.recommendedFor: Players who want adaptability and are comfortable managing more than one combat system

cards.name: Build Planning Rules
strengths: Makes resource spending easier to evaluate
Provides a clear path for later experimentation
weaknesses: Requires patience before committing to specialized combinations
May leave some options underdeveloped during the opening areas
Needs periodic adjustment as new content and encounters appear
cards.beginnerBuild: Prioritize one consistent source of damage, one emergency option, and upgrades that improve consistency rather than narrow specialization.
cards.hybridOption: Add a second damage role only after the primary setup can handle ordinary encounters without excessive resource expenditure.
cards.recommendedFor: Players who want a stable progression plan before testing unconventional combinations

divineFrequencyWalkthrough.title: Divine Frequency Walkthrough
divineFrequencyWalkthrough.intro: This walkthrough is organized around objectives rather than unrestricted exploration. Complete the essential steps first, record blocked routes for later, and return to optional areas when you have the resources or access needed to investigate them safely.

steps.title: Establish your route through the opening area
steps.description: Learn the basic combat and exploration systems, identify the main objective, and establish a mental map of accessible rooms, exits, and blocked paths before moving deeper into the first Act.
navigationTips: Check nearby side paths before committing to the next major objective.
Record doors or routes that cannot yet be opened.
Keep enough resources for the next required encounter rather than clearing every optional threat immediately.

steps.title: Investigate side rooms and unresolved access points
steps.description: Explore optional spaces connected to the opening route when it is safe to do so. Treat inaccessible paths as future checkpoints instead of spending excessive resources trying to force progress.
navigationTips: Return to side areas after completing nearby essential objectives.
Use landmarks to distinguish visited routes from unexplored branches.
Prioritize discoveries that provide useful resources or clarify the surrounding area.

steps.title: Advance through the second Act's objective chain
steps.description: Follow the active story objectives through the currently available Act II content. Reassess your combat setup as encounter ranges, resource demands, and navigation complexity increase.
navigationTips: Keep one reliable firearm or psionic option available for sustained encounters.
Do not spend every high-impact resource before confirming the next objective.
When progression appears blocked, review earlier unresolved routes and completed objectives.

steps.title: Return for optional encounters and discoveries
steps.description: After completing the immediate story requirement, revisit previously marked branches and optional spaces. This is the safest time to investigate content that was too costly or inaccessible during the first pass.
navigationTips: Use your notes or remembered landmarks to avoid repeating a complete search.
Bring a balanced loadout when the optional route's encounter type is unknown.
Separate optional discoveries from objectives required to advance the current Act.

steps.title: Confirm completion before leaving an area
steps.description: Before moving on, verify that the main objective has advanced, important resources have been collected, and blocked paths have been recorded. This reduces backtracking when the Early Access content expands or changes.
navigationTips: Check the objective state after major interactions.
Keep unresolved locations in a short return list.
Avoid assuming that every unexplored room is required for story progression.

divineFrequencyEnemyGuide.title: Divine Frequency Enemy Guide
divineFrequencyEnemyGuide.intro: Use this guide to organize enemy encounters by the decisions that matter most: how an enemy approaches, which attacks create the greatest risk, when to disengage, and which resources should be reserved for difficult situations. Early encounters reward observation and positioning more than repeated attacks.

enemies.name: Early-Act Hostiles
enemies.attackPattern: Close-range pressure, predictable pursuit, and repeated attacks when the player remains in a confined area.
enemies.weakness: Limited mobility and clear recovery windows after an attack.
tactics: Create distance before attempting another attack.
Use corners and doorways to control the approach.
Avoid spending rare healing or ammunition on an isolated target unless retreat is impossible.
equipment: A light source for maintaining visual awareness
enemies.preparation: Enter unfamiliar rooms with an escape route already identified and avoid triggering multiple encounters at once.

enemies.name: Fast Pursuers
enemies.attackPattern: Rapid closing distance followed by short attack chains that become dangerous when the player is trapped against scenery.
enemies.weakness: Poor performance when forced to navigate around obstacles or follow through narrow routes.
tactics: Break line of sight instead of trying to defeat the pursuer immediately.
Move through previously cleared spaces rather than retreating into unknown rooms.
Attack only during a recovery animation or after the pursuer misses.
equipment: Emergency healing reserved for failed escapes
enemies.preparation: Keep important doors and traversal routes accessible before interacting with suspicious objects or entering optional areas.

enemies.name: Special-Preparation Encounters
enemies.attackPattern: High-pressure encounters that combine limited space, environmental hazards, or repeated waves of danger.
enemies.weakness: The encounter structure generally provides a brief preparation window before the danger escalates.
tactics: Inspect the surrounding area before activating the encounter.
Use the environment to separate threats whenever possible.
Reserve the strongest equipment for the final phase rather than the opening exchange.
equipment: The strongest available weapon or defensive item
A clear inventory with room for encounter rewards
enemies.preparation: Save before entering a clearly marked high-risk area and complete nearby exploration first so that the encounter does not interrupt unfinished objectives.

divineFrequencySecretsAndPuzzles.title: Divine Frequency Secrets and Puzzles
divineFrequencySecretsAndPuzzles.intro: Each entry is arranged from lightest spoiler to complete resolution. Start with the observation prompt, reveal the first hint only when needed, and open the solution section after exhausting the environmental clues.

entries.title: Environmental Clue Reading
entries.observation: Examine unusual markings, repeated symbols, object placement, lighting changes, and areas that appear deliberately framed by the environment.
entries.hint1: Compare nearby rooms and note which details repeat and which detail appears only once.
entries.hint2: Treat repeated visual elements as instructions or sequence markers rather than decoration.
entries.solution: Use the unique environmental detail to identify the relevant interaction order, then return to the marked object or mechanism.

entries.title: Optional Area Checks
entries.observation: Before leaving a major exploration space, check side rooms, blocked sightlines, unusual wall sections, and routes that become accessible after nearby interactions.
entries.hint1: Revisit spaces after a story interaction changes the environment or unlocks a new traversal option.
entries.hint2: The most valuable optional paths are often adjacent to, rather than directly inside, the main route.
entries.solution: Finish the immediate objective, return through previously visited rooms, and inspect newly accessible branches for secret items and lore entries.

entries.title: Optional Encounter Preparation
entries.observation: An area with unusual sound design, restricted movement, repeated visual motifs, or conspicuous empty space may conceal an optional encounter.
entries.hint1: Check the area for interactable objects before committing to the encounter.
entries.hint2: Prepare healing and combat resources, then identify the nearest safe retreat route.
entries.solution: Complete the environmental interaction that activates the hidden event, survive the encounter, and search the arena afterward for its reward or lore item.

divineFrequencySettingsAndSystemRequirem.title: Divine Frequency Settings and System Requirements
divineFrequencySettingsAndSystemRequirem.intro: Begin with the game's recommended display and quality settings, then adjust individual options rather than lowering everything at once. For Early Access builds, keeping drivers current and testing performance in a representative gameplay area is more useful than relying only on menu benchmarks.

rows.recommendedUse: Use fullscreen or borderless mode according to desktop switching preference.
rows.troubleshooting: If the image flickers or frame pacing feels inconsistent, switch display mode and restart the game.

rows.setting: Native resolution with available scaling options
rows.recommendedUse: Start at the monitor's native resolution, then reduce rendering resolution or enable supported upscaling if performance is unstable.
rows.troubleshooting: Lower resolution before reducing every visual-quality setting; this provides a clear test of whether the GPU is the limiting factor.

rows.recommendedUse: Use the default preset first, then reduce shadows, effects, and post-processing individually when needed.
rows.troubleshooting: Apply one change at a time and test in a demanding interior or exploration area before making further adjustments.

rows.recommendedUse: Confirm button prompts, sensitivity, vibration, and movement settings before beginning a long session.
rows.troubleshooting: Reconnect the controller before launch if inputs are not detected, then verify the active input device in the game's settings.

rows.setting: Frame pacing, background applications, and driver state
rows.recommendedUse: Close unnecessary overlays and background applications while testing the Early Access build.
rows.troubleshooting: Update graphics drivers, verify the installation through Steam, restart the game after changing major graphics options, and cap the frame rate if pacing is uneven.

divineFrequencyUpdatesAndRoadmap.title: Divine Frequency Updates and Early Access Roadmap
divineFrequencyUpdatesAndRoadmap.intro: Use this archive to separate features available in the current build from improvements announced for later development. Each entry is grouped by its development status so players can understand whether a change is playable now, part of a released update, or still planned.

entries.title: Current Early Access Build
content: The game is playable through its currently released Early Access content.
Current systems, encounters, performance, and presentation may continue to receive iterative improvements.
Players should use the latest Steam build when checking whether a reported issue has already been addressed.
entries.playerImpact: Start a new session only after allowing Steam to finish pending updates, especially when using an older installation.

entries.title: Post-Launch Fixes and Quality Improvements
content: Official updates may address crashes, progression blockers, interaction issues, visual defects, and performance problems.
Balance changes can affect encounter difficulty, resource availability, or the effectiveness of existing tactics.
Patch notes should be read alongside community reports when diagnosing a problem that appears after an update.
entries.playerImpact: After a major patch, verify settings and revisit previously blocked interactions before assuming that a save file is permanently affected.

entries.title: Planned Early Access Development
content: The Early Access roadmap covers continued development toward the broader full-game vision.
Planned improvements may include additional content, system refinement, balancing, polish, and technical optimization.
Features listed for later development are not treated as available until they appear in an official released build.
entries.playerImpact: Players purchasing during Early Access should expect the game to evolve through future updates rather than remain feature-complete at the initial release state.

entries.title: Official Announcement Channels
content: Steam announcements provide the primary update and patch-note archive.
The official social channels provide development announcements and release communication.
Community discussion can provide context for reported issues, but released patch notes determine the current supported feature set.
entries.playerImpact: Check the latest official announcement before beginning a new playthrough after a major version change.

questions.question: What is Divine Frequency?
questions.answer: Divine Frequency is a surreal retro horror FPS by Abraxaes, blending brutal gunfights, RPG progression, psychological horror, and cosmic mysteries across collapsing realities.

questions.question: Is Divine Frequency available now?
questions.answer: Yes. Divine Frequency entered Steam Early Access on October 26, 2026, and is available for Windows PC.

questions.question: How much content is in the Divine Frequency Early Access version?
questions.answer: The Early Access build includes roughly 70% of the full game: 2 of 3 story chapters with around 4–6 hours of playtime in the current version.

questions.question: What will the full version of Divine Frequency include?
questions.answer: The full release is planned to add the complete campaign, additional enemies and bosses, more player builds, extra music and story elements, and a Hardcore Mode.

questions.question: How long will Divine Frequency stay in Early Access?
questions.answer: Early Access is expected to last about one year, though development may extend that to two years depending on progress toward the full-game vision.

questions.question: Where can I follow Divine Frequency updates?
questions.answer: Follow Steam announcements, the official Discord, X, and Bluesky channels for patch notes, development news, and Early Access roadmap updates.
